title: Warming seas threaten over 2,000 fishermen in Romblon town

blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — More than 2,000 registered fisherfolk and about 50 backyard fishpond operators in Odiongan, Romblon, could be affected by the increasingly hot weather and rising sea temperatures, according to the municipal agriculture office. Ocean warming is disrupting fishing conditions: fish move away from shallow, warmer areas, forcing marginal fisherfolk to venture farther offshore in search of catch. The situation could affect the livelihood of thousands of fishing families who depend on coastal waters for their daily income and food.
